title: [data-integrity 18/22] Filter trashed curated-view members before paging

labels.name: spec:approved
labels.description: Spec passed /define-behavior audit — ready for the dispatcher to pick up

body:
**Blocked by:** #664

## Context

`queryCuratedView` in `backend/packages/data/src/views/viewQuery.ts` (lines 95-128) pages a curated view by loading every `view_items` row (`viewItemsStore.listViewItems`, line 101), slicing `limit` memberships after the cursor position (lines 112-114), and only then resolving the items with `getItemsByIds` (line 116-124), which drops soft-deleted rows (`deleted_at IS NULL`, `itemsStore.ts` line 330). A page whose memberships point at trashed items comes back short — down to zero items — while `hasMore` (line 113) and `nextCursor` (line 127) say there is more. A view with many trashed members returns a series of empty pages, and a client that stops on the first empty page never reaches the live members after it. With `includeDeleted` (`inTrash`) the lookup is `getItemsByIdsIncludingDeleted` and the page is complete, so the defect is exactly the default case.

This issue depends on C7 because both change `viewQuery.ts` (C7 rewrites the cursor handling of `queryItemsCore` in the same file).

## Task

1. `backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/viewItemsStore.ts`: new exported `listLiveViewItemsAfter(client, viewId, input: { afterPosition: number | null; limit: number }): Promise<ViewItemRow[]>` — `SELECT m.view_id, m.item_id, m.position FROM view_items m JOIN items i ON i.id = m.item_id WHERE m.view_id = $1 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL [AND m.position > $3] ORDER BY m.position ASC LIMIT $2` (the join has no `database_id`, so it scans partitions the same way `getItemsByIds` already does — same justification as its comment at lines 318-325 of `itemsStore.ts`). `listViewItems` stays as is for the membership routes.
2. `queryCuratedView`: when `includeDeleted` is false, page the memberships with `listLiveViewItemsAfter(..., { afterPosition: cursorPosition ?? null, limit: limit + 1 })` and resolve them with `getItemsByIds`; when `includeDeleted` is true, keep the current in-memory path over `listViewItems` + `getItemsByIdsIncludingDeleted` (the trash listing wants trashed members). `hasMore`/`nextCursor` derive from the paged membership rows in both branches; the cursor stays the last `position` as a string.
3. Tests in `backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/views.test.ts` (integration, in the existing curated-view describe): a curated view with 6 members where members 2, 3 and 4 are soft-deleted; `queryView(limit: 2)` returns members 1 and 5 with a `nextCursor`, the next page returns member 6 with `nextCursor: null`; with `inTrash: true` the pages contain the trashed members; a view whose members are all trashed returns `items: []` and `nextCursor: null` on the first page.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/viewItemsStore.ts (new `listLiveViewItemsAfter` export only)
- backend/packages/data/src/views/viewQuery.ts (`queryCuratedView` only)
- backend/packages/data/src/__tests__/views.test.ts

## Scope

### In scope
- Filtering trashed members before paging, and the tests.

### Out of scope
- Sorted/filtered view paging (C7) and rollup columns (C8).
- Removing `view_items` rows for purged items (sibling issue C2).
- `views_one_default_per_db` and curated-view creation rules.

## Acceptance criteria

- When a curated view has soft-deleted members, each default page contains exactly `limit` live items (or fewer only on the last page) and `nextCursor` is `null` exactly when no live member follows.
- When `inTrash: true` is requested, trashed members are included in the pages as before.
- When every member is trashed, the first page is empty with `nextCursor: null`.
